# LayoutNode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

One node in the layout tree: a rendered element and the area(s) it occupied.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`a11y`](#a11y): Intrinsic accessibility facts, when the element declares a role.
- [`children`](#children): The nodes laid out inside this one, in render order.
- [`id`](#id): Stable within one snapshot; assigned in deterministic render order.
- [`name`](#name): Optional author-supplied name/key (e.g. from a future capture API).
- [`paint`](#paint): Intrinsic colour/typography facts, when the element paints any.
- [`rects`](#rects): The rectangles this node occupied — one per page it touched (may be empty).
- [`sourceId`](#sourceid): Opaque editor-owned source id; present only in instrumented preview builds.
- [`type`](#type): Canonical element type name, e.g. "TextBlock", "Table", "Page".
